newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Huangshan sets B share price at US$0.24-$0.29.
newsitem.headline: Huangshan sets B share price at US$0.24-$0.29.

text.p: Huangshan Tourism Development Co Ltd, based in Anhui, China, has tentatively set its price for 80 million B shares at between US$0.24 and US$0.29 a share, an official of the main domestic underwriter said on Wednesday.

The issue will have a price/earnings ratio of six to 7.2 times based on forecast 1996 net earnings of 72 million yuan, the official of Guotai Securities told the Hong Kong-based newsletter, the China Securities Bulletin.
The official said he expects to kick off the offer next week, with Peregrine Capital Ltd appointed as international coordinator. The B shares are due to be listed on the Shanghai exchange, he said.

Huangshan plans to use the proceeds from the offer to build a third cableway at the Huangshan mountain resort and renovation of a hotel there, he said. The 80-million-yuan cableway is nearing completion, he added.
Huangshan forecast net earnings of 72 million yuan for 1996, compared with 45 million yuan last year and 30 million yuan in 1994, he said.

He said the firm's business has been helped by an increasing number of tourists to the Huangshan resort, in the eastern province of Anhui, with Huangshan Tourism receiving 845,000 tourists in 1995. The firm received 670,000 tourists in the January-June period this year, he said.
Following the B share issue, Huangshan's total share capital will rise to 193 million shares, including 113 million state shares.
Earlier, a company spokesman said Huangshan planned to follow the B share offer with an issue of 30 million A shares to tap funds held by mainland investors. He did not give details.
